question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Pleasant
solution:
The correct answer is 'Delightful.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the **meaning **of Pleasant:

 
 
• Pleasant: nice, enjoyable or friendly. (सुहाना, आनंददायक या अनुकूल)
 
 
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:
 
 
• Awful: **very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा, अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर)
 
• **Delightful: **causing delight; charming. (आनंदप्रद)
 
• **Faithful: **always staying with and supporting a person, organization or belief. ((व्‍यक्ति, संस्‍था, मत आदि के प्रति) सच्‍चा और निष्‍ठावान)
 
• **Sorrowful: **feeling or showing grief. (दुखपूर्ण, दुखी)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that word "Delightful" is the most appropriate synonym of the given word "Pleasant."
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.
